about: Touched-path → test-suite map (bothouse#236), read by `botq test-map`. The acceptance gate derives a landed change's touched paths from its own diff and requires the commands mapped here green. First matching rule wins: specific rules above broad ones. `tests: []` means CONSCIOUSLY untested and must carry its why. An unmapped path fails the resolver loud. Commands run from the repo root; lint completeness with `botq test-map --check`.

rules.why: editing the map re-lints its own completeness over every tracked file
prose and licenses — nothing executes them
the pinned dev environment: parsing catches a syntax error, and a build inside it catches a package that the toolchain or the wgpu/winit runtime loads actually needed

one crate, one suite. The WGSL rides the same rule because nothing parses it until a pipeline is built, which only the GPU tests in tests/ do — a shader typo is a runtime error, so `cargo build` alone would pass it. `cargo test` needs no --test-threads: the suite shares one wgpu device precisely so parallel tests cannot fight over device creation
